text:
Predicates:
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
LongVacation(x) ::: x has a long vacation.
Seasons ::: the set of all seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter.
Emma ::: Emma.
Mia ::: Mia.
James ::: James.

Premises:
∀x (WantLongVacation(x) → FavoriteSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(Emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
¬FavoriteSeason(Mia, Emma's) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.

Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(Mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
